title: 2.1 Artificial Intelligence
description: Exhaustive coverage of AI definitions, history, branches, expert systems, and real-world applications from Grade 11 ICT Unit 2.

questions.question: How is an emerging technology defined in the Grade 11 ICT curriculum?
options: A technology that is developing and evolving fast with a prominent socio-economic impact
A static technology that has been utilized in business for over fifty years
A proprietary software application exclusive to government departments
A deprecated hardware protocol replaced by modern wireless standards
questions.correctAnswer: A technology that is developing and evolving fast with a prominent socio-economic impact

questions.question: What is the primary definition of Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
options: A branch of computer science that deals with the design of systems that mimic human intelligence
A database software designed solely for electronic fund transfers in banks
A physical telecommunications cable connecting disparate local area networks
An operating system designed specifically for server mainframe computers
questions.correctAnswer: A branch of computer science that deals with the design of systems that mimic human intelligence

questions.question: Which two capabilities are AI systems designed to possess that were traditionally considered unique to humans?
options: Reasoning and generalization
Capacitance and conduction
Compilation and interpretation
Defragmentation and indexing
questions.correctAnswer: Reasoning and generalization

questions.question: Which of the following scenarios is an example of reasoning as described in the textbook?
options: My friend is either at home or in her workplace. My friend is not in her workplace. Therefore, my friend is at home.
I know how to change a bicycle wheel, so I can change the wheel on my friend's bicycle.
Replacing a damaged motherboard with an identical model after running POST diagnostics.
Entering student marks into a database to generate a quarterly ranking report.
questions.correctAnswer: My friend is either at home or in her workplace. My friend is not in her workplace. Therefore, my friend is at home.

questions.question: What does generalization in artificial intelligence refer to?
options: Applying past experiences to current problems of similar nature
Deleting redundant records across relational database tables
Converting continuous analog signals into binary discrete values
Scanning storage disks to eliminate fragmented sectors
questions.correctAnswer: Applying past experiences to current problems of similar nature

questions.question: In which decade does the history of artificial intelligence begin, according to the textbook?
options: The 1940s
The 1920s
The 1970s
The 1990s
questions.correctAnswer: The 1940s

questions.question: In which decade was the term 'Artificial Intelligence' officially coined?
options: The 1950s
The 1930s
The 1960s
The 1980s
questions.correctAnswer: The 1950s

questions.question: What are the two main drivers behind the rapid growth and popularity of AI today?
options: Significant growth in computer capacity and the availability of large amounts of data
The abandonment of relational databases and lower hardware production costs
The universal adoption of dial-up modems and analog televisions
Decreased energy costs and mandatory government mandates
questions.correctAnswer: Significant growth in computer capacity and the availability of large amounts of data

questions.question: What is Machine Learning?
options: The study of computer algorithms that enable computers to learn from data and improve without being explicitly programmed
The physical assembly of robotic components along an automobile manufacturing line
The manual coding of if-then statements for every single real-world contingency
The transmission of binary data over fiber-optic telecommunication cables
questions.correctAnswer: The study of computer algorithms that enable computers to learn from data and improve without being explicitly programmed

questions.question: From what source do machine learning algorithms acquire their ability to improve?
options: Experience
Compiler syntax checks
BIOS configuration settings
Surge protectors
questions.correctAnswer: Experience

questions.question: How do machine learning algorithms fundamentally differ from conventional computer algorithms?
options: Machine learning algorithms train on sample data inputs to build predictive models rather than following explicit programmed instructions
Conventional algorithms learn from experience while machine learning relies purely on manual logic gates
Machine learning algorithms run without requiring memory or electrical power
Conventional algorithms only run on mobile devices whereas machine learning runs on analog circuits
questions.correctAnswer: Machine learning algorithms train on sample data inputs to build predictive models rather than following explicit programmed instructions

questions.question: Which group of applications is explicitly cited in the textbook as examples of Machine Learning?
options: Fraud detection, recommendation systems, email spam detector, and speech recognition
Disk defragmentation, CMOS battery replacement, and POST diagnostic beeps
HTML table creation, anchor hyperlinks, and ordered list numbering
Relational entity creation, SQL query writing, and primary key definition
questions.correctAnswer: Fraud detection, recommendation systems, email spam detector, and speech recognition

questions.question: What is Robotics defined as in the curriculum?
options: The study of machines called robots that substitute tasks that are traditionally done by human beings
The electronic manipulation of audio signals through teleconferencing codecs
The conversion of high-level programming code into machine language instructions
The process of de-identifying personal data in medical records
questions.correctAnswer: The study of machines called robots that substitute tasks that are traditionally done by human beings

questions.question: In which industrial sector have robots been primarily used over the past few decades to replace routine human labor?
options: Car manufacturing assembly lines
Textbook publishing editorial offices
Agricultural manual cotton harvesting
Handmade pottery studios
questions.correctAnswer: Car manufacturing assembly lines

questions.question: Which hazardous environments are highlighted as suitable domains for robotic deployment?
options: Handling radioactive wastes, underwater environments, and space explorations
Air-conditioned computer laboratories and primary school classrooms
Municipal libraries and local grocery checkout counters
Customer service call centers and banking reception desks
questions.correctAnswer: Handling radioactive wastes, underwater environments, and space explorations

questions.question: What household machine is highlighted as a well-known example of robots working without human intervention in homes?
options: Robot vacuum cleaner
Microwave oven
Analog refrigerator
Electric water kettle
questions.correctAnswer: Robot vacuum cleaner

questions.question: What is Natural Language Processing (NLP)?
options: A branch of AI that deals with enabling computers to understand written and spoken human language in the same way humans do
A low-level assembly language translator that converts mnemonics to binary machine code
A relational database query language designed for manipulating entity tables
A hardware protocol that regulates voltage supplied to motherboard components
questions.correctAnswer: A branch of AI that deals with enabling computers to understand written and spoken human language in the same way humans do

questions.question: Which email service provider is explicitly named in the textbook as using NLP to analyze email text for spam detection?
options: Yahoo
Hotmail
ProtonMail
AOL
questions.correctAnswer: Yahoo

questions.question: Which translation system is explicitly mentioned as using NLP to translate text from one language to another?
options: Google Translate
DeepL
Babylon Translator
Systran
questions.correctAnswer: Google Translate

questions.question: Which two voice-operated virtual assistants are cited in the textbook as examples of NLP in action?
options: Amazon's Alexa and Apple's Siri
Microsoft Cortana and Samsung Bixby
Google Assistant and IBM Watson
Mycin and Robonaut
questions.correctAnswer: Amazon's Alexa and Apple's Siri

questions.question: What is Sentiment Analysis in NLP?
options: Extracting and analyzing users' social media data to determine opinions as negative, positive, or neutral
Predicting the exact atmospheric temperature from satellite meteorological imagery
Compressing high-definition video streams for real-time teleconferencing
Filtering duplicate records from a relational database table
questions.correctAnswer: Extracting and analyzing users' social media data to determine opinions as negative, positive, or neutral

questions.question: How does NLP contribute to fake news identification?
options: By identifying whether news is trustworthy and checking the reliability of its source
By permanently deleting unverified social media profiles
By encrypting articles using symmetric cryptographic keys
By converting online text into high-resolution vector images
questions.correctAnswer: By identifying whether news is trustworthy and checking the reliability of its source

questions.question: What is Text Summarization in NLP?
options: Automatically generating a concise summary of a large piece of document such as an academic article
Translating spoken dialect audio into written English text
Counting total characters in a document to determine printer toner usage
Splitting a single paragraph into multiple HTML table cells
questions.correctAnswer: Automatically generating a concise summary of a large piece of document such as an academic article

questions.question: What are Expert Systems?
options: Computer programs that emulate human experts to solve problems normally solved by human experts
Hardware diagnostic cards that evaluate CPU voltage fluctuations
Operating systems designed specifically to format hard drives
Mobile applications created to manage personal fitness schedules
questions.correctAnswer: Computer programs that emulate human experts to solve problems normally solved by human experts

questions.question: Which three professional fields are cited in the textbook as benefiting from expert systems?
options: Medical diagnosis, petroleum engineering, and financial investing
Textile manufacturing, furniture design, and carpentry
Music production, sculpture carving, and oil painting
Postal sorting, paper recycling, and masonry
questions.correctAnswer: Medical diagnosis, petroleum engineering, and financial investing

questions.question: What are the three core components of an Expert System?
options: User Interface, Knowledge Base, and Inference Engine
CPU, RAM, and Hard Disk
Compiler, Assembler, and Interpreter
Entity, Attribute, and Relationship
questions.correctAnswer: User Interface, Knowledge Base, and Inference Engine

questions.question: What is the function of the User Interface component in an Expert System?
options: Accepts queries from the user, forwards them to the inference engine, and displays the recommendations
Executes machine code instructions in binary format
Stores employee payroll tables in an isolated spreadsheet
Calculates power voltage requirements for hardware peripherals
questions.correctAnswer: Accepts queries from the user, forwards them to the inference engine, and displays the recommendations

questions.question: How is knowledge typically structured inside the Knowledge Base of an expert system?
options: In the form of if-then-else rules comprising factual and heuristic knowledge
As comma-separated plain text strings without rules
As unindexed binary image files stored on optical disks
In sequential punched cards organized by date of entry
questions.correctAnswer: In the form of if-then-else rules comprising factual and heuristic knowledge

questions.question: What type of knowledge in an expert system represents experiential or common-sense rules?
options: Heuristic knowledge
Factual knowledge
Procedural SQL code
Relational syntax
questions.correctAnswer: Heuristic knowledge

questions.question: What is the role of the Inference Engine in an Expert System?
options: It acts as the brain of the expert system that produces answers by referencing the knowledge base
It provides physical internet connectivity between workstations
It collects user demographic data through web browser forms
It converts AC power from the wall into regulated DC power
questions.correctAnswer: It acts as the brain of the expert system that produces answers by referencing the knowledge base

questions.question: What was MYCIN, one of the earliest and most well-known expert systems?
options: An expert system that emulates infectious disease experts, identifies bacteria causing infections, and recommends antibiotics
A software package that forecasts commodity price fluctuations on international stock markets
An autonomous rover built by NASA to traverse lunar craters
A search engine ranking algorithm developed by Google to index medical journals
questions.correctAnswer: An expert system that emulates infectious disease experts, identifies bacteria causing infections, and recommends antibiotics

questions.question: How does artificial intelligence enhance the online shopping experience for users?
options: By processing massive user data to extract personalized profiles and recommend items shoppers are likely interested in
By eliminating all shipping and packaging costs for international parcels
By replacing all human couriers with submarine transport vessels
By requiring users to manually calculate inventory tax percentages
questions.correctAnswer: By processing massive user data to extract personalized profiles and recommend items shoppers are likely interested in

questions.question: Which data sources do autonomous cars collect information from to function without human intervention?
options: GPS, vehicle radar, and cameras
Barometer, thermometer, and paper road maps
FM radio signals, tachometers, and spark plugs
Printed municipal blueprints and traffic officer whistles
questions.correctAnswer: GPS, vehicle radar, and cameras

questions.question: Which automobile company is explicitly cited in the textbook as having implemented autopilot features in its cars?
options: Tesla
Toyota
Ford
Mercedes-Benz
questions.correctAnswer: Tesla

questions.question: Which capability of autonomous cars is expected to significantly reduce road accidents?
options: Exchanging safety-critical information with each other, having a 360-degree surrounding view, and flagging road hazards ahead
Operating at unlimited travel speeds regardless of road surface weather
Bypassing municipal traffic signals and one-way road restrictions
Using aircraft fuel to increase engine combustion acceleration
questions.correctAnswer: Exchanging safety-critical information with each other, having a 360-degree surrounding view, and flagging road hazards ahead

questions.question: Which social media company is highlighted in the textbook as applying AI for advertising, personalized content delivery, and facial recognition?
options: Facebook
LinkedIn
Twitter
Pinterest
questions.correctAnswer: Facebook

questions.question: How do modern surveillance systems utilize artificial intelligence?
options: By automatically detecting suspicious behavior in real-time in locations like supermarkets and security stations
By permanently disabling all closed-circuit camera lenses during nighttime hours
By storing uncompressed footage exclusively on magnetic floppy disks
By replacing physical security perimeters with acoustic broadcast warnings
questions.correctAnswer: By automatically detecting suspicious behavior in real-time in locations like supermarkets and security stations

questions.question: What are primary applications of AI in agriculture listed in the curriculum?
options: Precision farming, detection of pests, monitoring soil and crop health, and climate advisory systems
Manual seed scattering, ox-driven plowing, and sickle weed cutting
Replacing plant photosynthesis with artificial ultraviolet grow lamps
Eliminating nitrogen and phosphorus cycles from agricultural fields
questions.correctAnswer: Precision farming, detection of pests, monitoring soil and crop health, and climate advisory systems

questions.question: What is a chatbot in customer service?
options: A system that simulates human conversation through text or voice commands to provide fast and cheaper customer support
A robotic arm deployed along an industrial assembly line to package goods
An automated banking machine that dispenses paper currency upon card insertion
A network switch that forwards data packets between disparate subnets
questions.correctAnswer: A system that simulates human conversation through text or voice commands to provide fast and cheaper customer support

questions.question: What is the name of the NASA robot designed to work alongside astronauts on the International Space Station (ISS)?
options: Robonaut
Curiosity
Perseverance
Opportunity
questions.correctAnswer: Robonaut

questions.question: What functions does Robonaut perform on the International Space Station?
options: It uses many of the tools that an astronaut uses and performs tasks normally done by human beings
It serves as the main orbital propulsion engine for the space station
It manages the financial accounting books of NASA contractors
It transmits audio commercial broadcasts to Earth radio receivers
questions.correctAnswer: It uses many of the tools that an astronaut uses and performs tasks normally done by human beings

questions.question: How do artificial intelligence systems assist in smart homes?
options: By assisting in home security, household chores, and smoke alerting
By eliminating the need for electrical wiring and plumbing in the house
By converting household waste directly into potable mineral water
By automatically drafting legal real estate property transfer contracts
questions.correctAnswer: By assisting in home security, household chores, and smoke alerting

questions.question: How do banking institutions leverage AI for fraud prevention?
options: By tracing patterns in credit card transactions to detect fraudulent activities
By requiring physical thumbprint ink stamps on all paper checks
By restricting all ATM withdrawals to local daytime branch hours
By storing client ledger balances on paper index cards
questions.correctAnswer: By tracing patterns in credit card transactions to detect fraudulent activities

questions.question: What is the name of Google's AI ranking algorithm that determines the order of search results?
options: Google RankBrain
Google PageRank
Google DeepSearch
Google AlphaIndex
questions.correctAnswer: Google RankBrain
